summary.notes: Ethereum-side mint-burn exploit inventory assembled from the 2026 Rekt incident page and Truebit official resources. The public record includes the vulnerable purchase contract, attack contract, primary exploiter, laundering wallet, and a secondary copycat attacker.

contractAddresses.name: PurchaseContract
contractAddresses.notes: Affected purchase contract acknowledged by Truebit.

contractAddresses.name: PrimaryAttackerEOA
contractAddresses.notes: Primary exploiter wallet traced in the Rekt article.

contractAddresses.name: AttackContract
contractAddresses.notes: Malicious contract deployed and executed in the same block as the exploit.

contractAddresses.name: TornadoCashLaunderingWallet
contractAddresses.notes: Wallet used to route the stolen ETH toward Tornado Cash.

contractAddresses.name: SecondAttackerWallet
contractAddresses.notes: Copycat attacker wallet that extracted smaller follow-on profits.

resolutionStrategy: Use Truebit official resources for project identity and product context
Treat the exploit contract and attacker wallets from the incident page as high-confidence replay anchors
Expand with token and governance deployment addresses later if they are recovered from verified historical repos or explorer labels
